defects.claim: Description: 'head tilted down a few degrees'. Renderer has no pitch joint; neck field produces roll (side tilt). neck=20 tilts head to figure's RIGHT per corrected convention. Should be 0 (no side tilt; 'down a few degrees' is pitch, not addressable).

failing_tests.expected: both arms forward + deep elbow flexion, hands near midline
failing_tests.actual: left arm at side, right arm lateral/overhead

rationale: Per protocol §4 use INSTRUCTIONS as ground truth (name 'twist back' but description is self-hug). (1) Self-hug approximation: both arms forward (shoulderFwdL/R=-60 per corrected convention - = forward) with deep elbow flexion (110°) to bring hands toward midline; renderer elbow is rotY-only so hands stay at shoulder width (rig-limited). (2) Symmetric kneeling: leftHip 0→70 (match right); both knees at 80 unchanged. (3) neck 20→0 (no side tilt; 'head tilted down' = pitch, not modeled). (4) spine 26→12 (mild forward fold for 'tender/introspective' mood, less extreme). Rig limitation: no horizontal adduction joint prevents true palms-to-torso contact; forward+deep-flexion is closest approximation.
